parameters.query: SELECT 1 AS seen FROM omar.messages WHERE wa_message_id = $1 LIMIT 1;
SELECT prompt_text, version FROM omar.agent_prompts WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH old AS (
  SELECT last_seen FROM omar.contacts WHERE phone = $1
)
INSERT INTO omar.contacts (phone, name, total_messages, last_seen)
VALUES ($1, NULLIF($2,''), 1, now())
ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET
  name           = COALESCE(omar.contacts.name, EXCLUDED.name),
  total_messages = omar.contacts.total_messages + 1,
  last_seen      = now()
RETURNING phone, name, email, wc_customer_id, mautic_contact_id,
  course_interest, lead_status::text AS lead_status, country, total_messages,
  COALESCE((SELECT round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - old.last_seen)) / 3600.0, 1) FROM old), -1) AS hours_since_last_seen,
  COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN old.last_seen >= now() - interval '48 hours'
                        THEN to_char(old.last_seen AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo', 'YYYY-MM-DD') END FROM old),
           to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS session_bucket;

INSERT INTO omar.messages (phone, role, body, media_url, wa_message_id)
VALUES ($1, 'customer', $2, NULLIF($3,''), $4)
ON CONFLICT (wa_message_id) WHERE wa_message_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

SELECT count(*)::int AS newer FROM omar.messages
WHERE phone = $1 AND role = 'customer' AND id > $2;

SELECT COALESCE(
  (SELECT string_agg(m.body, E'\n' ORDER BY m.id)
   FROM omar.messages m
   WHERE m.phone = $1 AND m.role = 'customer'
     AND m.id > COALESCE((SELECT max(o.id) FROM omar.messages o WHERE o.phone = $1 AND o.role = 'omar'), 0)),
  $2) AS batch;
